Zwraca, czy podana Instance ma wpis non-nil w Instance cache.

## Składnia

```lua
cache.iscached(instance: Instance): boolean
```

## Argumenty

| Name | Type | Required | Opis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `instance` | `Instance` | Yes | Instance, ktorej wpis Instance cache ma zostac sprawdzony. |

## Zwroty

| Name | Type | Opis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cached` | `boolean` | True, gdy cache zawiera wpis non-nil dla tej Instance. |

## Przykład

Sprawdz, czy Instance ma obecnie wpis w Instance cache Real.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local cached = cache.iscached(Players)
print(cached)

cache.invalidate(Players)
print(cache.iscached(Players))
```
